purpose: Retrieve rows from one or more tables
example: SELECT name, grade FROM students WHERE grade > 80;

purpose: Add a new row to a table

example: UPDATE students SET grade = 95 WHERE name = 'Sara';

purpose: Remove selected rows from a table
Remove all rows from a table quickly but keep the table structure
Permanently delete a table together with its data and structure

example: CREATE TABLE students (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50));

purpose: Change the structure of a table, for example add a column
example: ALTER TABLE students ADD email VARCHAR(100);

purpose: Combine rows from two tables that have matching values
example: SELECT s.name, c.title FROM students s INNER JOIN courses c ON s.course_id = c.id;

purpose: Group rows and apply aggregate functions to each group
example: SELECT course_id, AVG(grade) FROM students GROUP BY course_id;

purpose: Sort the result of a query
example: SELECT * FROM students ORDER BY grade DESC;

purpose: Create an index to speed up searches on a column
